name: Kon'ya no Otsumami ~Musuko-tachi no Yome wa Mitsu no Aji~
original_name: 今夜のお妻味 ～息子達の嫁は蜜の味～
source:
The main character has been living alone and has felt lonely ever since his wife passed away due to illness. One day, though, his luck completely changes.

His three sons have come back to live with him, each with his own wife. This is the start of a life full of temptation with his three gorgeous daughters-in-law!

[Translated from [url=https://www.dlsite.com/pro/work/=/product_id/VJ011952.html/?unique_op=af&utm_medium=affiliate&utm_source=vndb.org%2F]DLsite[/url]]
translation:
主角自從妻子因病去世後便獨自生活，始終感到孤獨。然而，某天他的運氣徹底改變。

他的三個兒子帶著各自的妻子回來與他同住。與三位漂亮的媳婦共同生活、充滿誘惑的日子就此開始！

（譯自[url=https://www.dlsite.com/pro/work/=/product_id/VJ011952.html/?unique_op=af&utm_medium=affiliate&utm_source=vndb.org%2F]DLsite[/url]）
